property.name: filterByAction
property.label: Filter by Action
property.description: Only receive messages matching this action. Leave blank for all.

property.name: filterBySessionId
property.label: Filter by Session ID
property.description: Only receive messages matching this session ID. Leave blank for all.

property.name: ignoreAction
property.label: Ignore Action
property.description: Ignore messages matching this action (e.g. a refresh broadcast this same flow published). Leave blank to ignore none.

property.name: autoNavigate
property.label: Auto-Navigate on Receive
property.description: Automatically advance to the next screen when a message is received. Default: false.

property.name: allowRepeatMessages
property.label: Allow Repeat Messages
property.description: By default a repeat of the last identical message is suppressed. Set true when the same message should re-fire a reaction such as an in-place refresh. Default: false.

property.name: receivedRecordId
property.label: OUT - Record ID
property.description: Record ID from the received message.

property.name: receivedSessionId
property.label: OUT - Session ID
property.description: Session ID from the received message.

property.name: messageReceived
property.label: OUT - Message Received
property.description: True once a message has been received.

property.name: receivedCount
property.label: OUT - Received Count
property.description: Increments on every accepted message. Use as a reactive trigger source for screen actions (in-place refresh).
